If sentiment is >0.5 in the last 3 days and forecast is trending down, increase the forecast by 1–2% for the next 3 days.  
If sentiment is <0.3 in the last 3 days and forecast is trending up, reduce the forecast by 1–2% for the next 3 days.  
If forecast drops below 55% of recent 7-day average and sentiment is neutral, add a 1–3% upward bias for the next 5 days.  
If forecast is above 65% of recent 7-day average and sentiment is bullish (≥0.7), apply a 1–2% downward correction for the next 5 days.  
In early horizon (first 7 days), if sentiment is consistently >0.6, shift forecast 0.5–1.5% higher than model baseline.  
In late horizon (last 7 days), if sentiment is consistently <0.3, shift forecast 0.5–1.5% lower than model baseline.
